sessionHistory: Production conversation store was empty for historical sessions; previous visible message bodies were browser-local UI state, not durable server history.
The v0.2.5 startup path pruned sessionUiState before server import, so older cached bodies could disappear from the conversation pane after update.
The fix imports raw boot local cache into ConversationStore before pruning, imports /api/ui-state cached messages server-side, pre-persists new user messages, and backfills final assistant replies.
imageRoute: The hot in-process image provider runner accepted image_url but ignored image_urls, so reference/edit inputs could be dropped and degrade to plain text-to-image.
The image-generation skill documentation still presented scripts/generate.py as the primary route, which could steer agents toward Python/script generation instead of the native imagegen tool.
The fix normalizes image_urls to the edit/reference route in the runtime runner and fallback script, and strengthens tool/skill instructions around native imagegen plus gpt-image-2-pro defaults.

recoveryBoundary.recoverable: Old message bodies still present in a user's browser localStorage are imported on the next WebUI load/refresh.
recoveryBoundary.notRecoverable: Message bodies already overwritten in browser localStorage and absent from the server ConversationStore cannot be reconstructed from the empty production backend DB.
